method.value: Use calibrated SV data; extract line channels; derive visibility weights from dispersion among 70 nearest uv points

evidence.quote: We derive the uncertainties on the visibilities by calculating the the dispersion among the 70 visibility points with baselines closest to the particular uv point.

key_parameters.value: CO(3-2) low-res binned to 0.3 km/s, central 15 channels; high-res 0.1 km/s, 101 channels

evidence.quote: The low-resolution spectrum has been binned to a resolution of 0.3 km/s and includes only the central 15 channels.

method.value: Parametric temperature and surface density structure, hydrostatic vertical structure, Keplerian plus pressure support velocity, LTE radiative transfer with thermal plus turbulent broadening; model visibilities by UVMODEL

evidence.quote: We use the MIRIAD task UVMODEL to generate model visibilities sampled at the same spatial frequencies as the data.

key_parameters.value: Fixed: d=122 pc, M*=2.3 Msun, PA=312 deg, Mgas=0.09 Msun, CO/H2=1e-4 (unless varied)

evidence.quote: we keep the distance (d=122pc), stellar mass ($M_*$=2.3$M_{\odot}$) and position angle (PA=312$^{o}$) fixed

assumptions.value: CO frozen out below 19 K and photodissociated above column threshold (abundance reduced by 8 orders of magnitude); LTE; mu=2.37

evidence.quote: We simulate freeze-out by decreasing the CO abundance by eight orders of magnitude in regions where the gas temperature drops below 19 K.

analysis_steps.goal: MCMC fit of each line and all four lines

method.value: Chi-squared likelihood on visibilities, emcee affine-invariant sampler; flux scale factors s with 20% Gaussian prior in multiline fit

evidence.quote: we employ the affine-invariant routine EMCEE (cite: for13) based on the algorithm originally presented in (cite: goo10)

key_parameters.value: Typically 40 walkers, 3000 steps; CO(3-2) 1500 steps with 1000 burn-in; multiline 60 walkers, 1000 steps, 500 burn-in

evidence.quote: For this MCMC trial we employ 60 walkers over 1000 steps, with the first 500 removed as burn-in.

assumptions.value: Mgas, Rc, vturb positive with uniform priors

evidence.quote: We require that $M_{\rm gas}$, $R_c$, and $v_{\rm turb}$ are positive with uniform priors across the parameter space.

fitting.value: chi-squared likelihood; median and 3 sigma ranges reported

evidence.quote: The goodness of fit between the model (V$_{\rm mod}$) and observed (V$_{\rm obs}$) visibilities is calculated using the chi-squared statistic

validation.value: Reduced chi-squared, residual channel maps, tests with flux scale 0.8/1.2, distance 112/132 pc, vturb fixed at 0.1 km/s

results_numeric.quantity: CO depletion factor relative to ISM (multiline)

evidence.quote: We find that CO is depleted by a factor of 4.9$^{+0.6}_{-0.4}$ relative to the canonical ISM value.

findings_qualitative.value: Turbulence in the outer disk upper layers is far below MRI simulation predictions and below the level implied by accretion rate

evidence.quote: Our limits also fall below predictions from numerical simulations of the MRI, suggesting that MRI is less efficient in the outer disk than previously thought.

claims.hypothesis: Is there strong non-thermal motion in the HD 163296 outer disk?
claims.finding: Turbulence is weak, below MRI predictions

evidence.quote: any contribution to the line-widths from turbulence is $<$3% of the local sound speed

claims.hypothesis: Do other lines and a joint fit agree?
claims.experiment: Fit CO(2-1), 13CO, C18O and all four lines together
claims.result: Limits of 0.31-0.40 cs individually, <0.16 cs jointly
claims.finding: Consistent with low turbulence, weaker constraints from lower resolution and optically thin lines

evidence.quote: The multi-line fit demonstrates that one consistent model, with weak turbulence, can fit all four lines.

claims.hypothesis: Is weak turbulence compatible with the high accretion rate?
claims.experiment: Compare alpha limit with accretion-implied alpha
claims.finding: Incompatible; alpha radially dependent or angular momentum removed otherwise

evidence.quote: The low disk mass and low turbulence appear to be incompatible with the high accretion rate onto the star.

why_this_method.value: Fitting full 3D visibilities uses spatial information, giving stronger diagnostic power than line broadening alone

evidence.quote: This behavior indicates that fitting a model to the full data set has a stronger diagnostic power than the broadening of the line in the spectral domain.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Reported upper limit rather than detection because unmodeled features (asymmetry, eccentricity) may be absorbed by turbulence

evidence.quote: For this reason we choose to report our turbulence results as an upper limit rather than a detection.

limitations_admitted.value: Parametric temperature structure cannot capture asymmetries; turbulence may be inflated; degeneracies between Tatm0 and Zq0, q and Rc

evidence.quote: The end result is a high value of turbulence, and a worse fit to the peak-to-trough ratio, due to limitations of the assumed temperature structure

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas temperature is parameterized, not computed, so limits depend on functional form
Zq0 fixed at 70 AU for CO(3-2)
Mgas fixed from dust, degenerate with CO/H2
Turbulence assumed isotropic and scaling with cs
